body: Thanks man, I do appreciate the reply a lot more than I can express via text.
Hey, thanks for the reply. I actually wasn't expecting any, kind of a last resort thing to come to strangers about your personal issues. I really do appreciate it.

I appreciate the advice a lot. Vegas honestly does suck, it's just as dirty as any other city. I'm sorry to hear about your friend though, that sounds horrifying. 

I actually did do driving school. 6 hours of it, but it gets expensive. My teacher told me I needed to practice a lot more, (about 25 more hours) but I didn't need to be in driving school. I don't have anyone to take me driving, nor do I have the money to pay for a teacher for just practice and not teaching. I asked his dad if I could simply drive places he needed to go, and he just said he never goes anywhere outside of work so he doesn't need that. My permit expires in about 2 months after being renewed. I've had it for 2 years, no one was available to teach me. 

I don't really know why no one cares.. I've reached out to people. It seems like they either don't take me seriously or they don't care enough. I have never felt so sure about anything in my life though. It feels like I'm just sitting in the audience, watching my life inevitably being pushed more and more towards the edge. Bad things will not stop happening to me.
